title: Jobs (Workflows)
markdown:
**What it is:** Structured, multi-step workflows that produce a *deliverable* — a board deck, a go-to-market plan, a performance review — rather than just a chat reply.

**What it does:**

- Browse the workflow catalog, grouped by area, with step counts and rough run time.
- Start a run and watch it stream its progress step by step.
- See your runs split into **Active**, **Done**, and **Error**, and search them by name.
- Build your own **custom workflow**: name it, define its inputs, and chain specialist, synthesis, and approval-gate steps.
- Put a workflow on a **schedule** (e.g. every Monday at 9:00) so it runs without being asked.
- Each finished run produces an artifact you can read and keep.

*Note: outputs land in Artifacts; a workflow that needs your sign-off mid-run will pause and ask.*
